seoTitle: Can You Add a PTR Record in Cloudflare? 2026 Answer
metaDescription: Find out whether Cloudflare supports adding PTR records directly, and how it compares to setting up MX, CNAME, and other DNS record types.
intro: PTR records are used for reverse DNS lookups, and many Cloudflare users wonder whether they can add one through the dashboard the same way they add an A or CNAME record. This guide covers what to know about PTR records in Cloudflare and how the more common DNS record types are managed there instead.

steps.heading: Understand what a PTR record does
steps.body: A PTR record maps an IP address back to a domain name, the reverse of a standard A record, and is most often used for email server verification.

steps.heading: Check where PTR records actually live
steps.body: PTR records are typically controlled by the entity that owns the IP address block — usually your hosting or cloud provider — rather than your domain's DNS zone.

steps.heading: Manage the DNS records Cloudflare does support
steps.body: In your Cloudflare dashboard, go to the DNS section for your domain, where you can add A, CNAME, MX, and TXT records directly.

steps.heading: Add an MX or CNAME record if that's your real goal
steps.body: If you're trying to set up email or point a subdomain elsewhere, use the Add Record option and select the MX or CNAME type instead of PTR.

steps.heading: Contact your hosting provider for reverse DNS
steps.body: If you specifically need a PTR record set up for an IP you control, request it through the provider that assigned that IP address.

faq.question: Can I add a PTR record directly in Cloudflare's DNS dashboard?
faq.answer: Cloudflare's standard DNS dashboard is built around forward records like A, CNAME, MX, and TXT — PTR records are managed by whoever controls the IP block, not through your domain zone.

faq.question: Why do I need a PTR record at all?
faq.answer: PTR records are commonly required for outbound email servers, since many mail providers check reverse DNS to reduce spam.

faq.question: Who do I contact to set up a PTR record?
faq.answer: Your hosting or cloud provider, since they control the IP address the record needs to point back to your domain.

faq.question: Can I still add an MX or TXT record in Cloudflare for email setup?
faq.answer: Yes, those record types are fully supported in the DNS section of your Cloudflare dashboard.
